note: The canonical watchlist. Every install fetches this file at run time, so a change here reaches all users on their next sweep -- no re-install. To add a developer account, website, or repo: edit this file, bump 'version', open a PR. Data only, never code.
watch: Either gateway returning 200 -- a backend finally serving.

The fix- lane phase winding down, hosts-/deploy lanes increasing.
Anything appearing in the Sidiora-Labs package list -- the first published image.
Third-party SID solvers, or SID's address in the bridge module.
New repos on the tracked accounts.
